cell_support: Retain original X/RCA global margins, filter M edges by X>=support before T recompute.
country_scale: Zero low-scale original fractional rows, recompute all global RCA margins; retained coauthor country fractions not renormalized.
coverage: Known-country fractional attribution mass, including UNKNOWN subject via primary-field totals; not whole-country sum claimed as unique global papers. Citation-event support is not distinct cited-target paper count.
display_only: Scores and M unchanged, only display/ranking universe filtered.
orientation: Each same-year result has raw scores plus one country-correlation multiplier applied jointly to its ECI/PCI for diagnostic comparison. Not a new temporal production model; weak correlation explicitly flagged.
rankings: Competition ranks, exact ties retained; no ranks when model disconnected/degenerate/empty.
